description: Elections Commission - The Media Guidelines made by the Election Commission under Article 104B(5)(a) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette contains Media Guidelines issued by the Election Commission under Article 104B(5)(a) of the Constitution, specifically regulating media conduct during election periods. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes, including rules for media coverage of elections, treatment of candidates and political parties, and procedures for maintaining electoral integrity. This falls squarely under "Electoral processes and related matters" as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
